headword: {車内|しゃない}{販売|はんばい}

definitions.gloss: on-board sales; trolley service on trains
definitions.explanation: The service of selling food, drinks, and souvenirs from a cart pushed through the aisles of trains, especially Shinkansen and limited express trains. This service has been declining in Japan due to changing passenger habits.

examples.japanese: {車内|しゃない}{販売|はんばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy coffee from the on-board trolley service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車内|しゃない}{販売|はんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}した→終了する：22990_shuuryousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Shinkansen's trolley service has been discontinued.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{車内|しゃない}{販売|はんばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧や⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だった。
examples.english: Buying boxed lunches and souvenirs from the trolley service used to be one of the pleasures of train travel.

notes:
USAGE:
A familiar term for anyone who has traveled by Shinkansen. JR East ended regular trolley service on the Tokaido Shinkansen in 2023, making this increasingly a nostalgic term, though some routes still offer it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車内|しゃない}{販売|はんばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ワゴン (the on-board sales cart)
- {車内|しゃない}{販売|はんばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧ (to use the trolley service)
- {車内|しゃない}{販売|はんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (trolley service to be abolished)
